title: Tytuvėnai Monastery South Wall Remains

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified open elevation tile data sampled at the independent building anchor.

mapIdentity.provider: Lithuanian Cultural Heritage Register and nearby mapped footprints
mapIdentity.scope: The mapped heritage point lies near the west end of the granary. The written record ties the remnant to the west extension of the granary’s north wall. Break positions and remaining heights are estimated.

note: Low broken brick wall west of the granary, with part of a narrow wicket and a remnant of a segmental niche.
